args.title: Tamarack Components – Warehouse Automation 2026 Summary
args.body:
- Newsletter headline: Warehouse automation in 2026 is driving major efficiency gains across the supply chain.
- Main article: Autonomous carts boosted pick rates by 18%, though full system integration took twice as long as originally planned.
- Companion piece: The largest cost/time saving came from a reduction in mis-picks, reinforcing automation's accuracy benefits over raw speed.
